[[True Swallow Flip]] (anime only; Tsubasa's) |WBO=https://worldbeyblade.org/Thread-Product-BX-24-Random-Booster-Vol-2-Rare-WyvernGale-5-80GB }}{{Translation|'''WyvernGale 5-80GB'''|ワイバーンゲイル{{Ruby|5-80|ファイブエイティー}}{{Ruby|GB|ギヤボール}}|WaibānGeiru Faibu Eitī Giya Bōru|WyvernGale Five Eighty Gear Ball}} is a Stamina Type Beyblade released by [[Takara Tomy]]. It was released in Japan on December 27th, 2023 for 1400円 as the prize Beyblade in [[Random Booster Vol. 2]]. It later debuted in western countries as '''Gale Wyvern 5-80GB''' as part of the [[Gale Wyvern and Tail Viper Dual Pack]] released by [[Hasbro]] for USD$14.99 in the United States.
